correctness.rationale: Every geometric fixed point has barycentric coefficients constant on edge H-orbits; positive edge-orbits must separately be matchings. A usable edge orbit crossing two transitive ground orbits must be graph of an equivariant bijection, existing exactly for isomorphic H/L sets, with |N_H(L)/L| choices. A usable internal edge-orbit is precisely a nonidentity equivariant fixed-point-free involution. Occupied ground-orbit positions disjoint iff compatible. This gives the exact join model; pairing j positions contributes m!/(2^j j!(m-2j)!)(wz)^j(1+sz)^(m-2j). Two regular orbits give K_(s,s) plus |H| isolates, H_1 rank (s-1)^2 and H_0 reduced rank |H| for s>=1. Independent V4 double-regular orbit edge enumeration found 10 model vertices (six internal, four cross), H_1=Z^4, H_0~=Z^4.

value.rationale: A natural uniform PL classification of fixed spaces of matching complexes under all finite group actions, including an exact f-polynomial and a noncyclic two-orbit topological discriminator. Normalizer quotient and involution count are motivated intrinsic group-action parameters; C4 and V4 have equal order but contrasting fixed topologies. Useful for equivariant topology and symmetry-sensitive chain computations, without claiming all higher homotopy classifications.

limitations: No universal homotopy wedge classification for arbitrary m>=3 factors and no normalizer action on their homology.
